audit.title: MatMix putty image systematic re-audit batch 1
audit.method: Public MatMix catalog API for exact live public scope and current image URLs; local image bytes fetched from those public URLs. No production DB access, SSH, apply, or deployment.

policy.keep: Current image meets clean white background, complete package, identity, quality, and visual framing standard; unchanged.
policy.reframe: Exact current production package retained; only whitespace crop, proportional scale, centering, and white canvas normalization.
policy.rebuild: Synthetic catalog render prepared only for owner review when exact identity is confirmed but a rights-cleared image is unavailable; official product media are visual references only, source pixels are not reused, and generated renders are not production-cleared by default.
policy.researchRequired: Use only while identity/source conflict remains unresolved. MAT-000046 identity is now confirmed; its generated candidate remains owner-review-only.

measurement.sourceFill: foreground bounding box width/height as percent of source dimensions
measurement.previewFill: same measurement on exact importer renderWebp 1200x1200 WebP

records.title: Шпаклевка гипсовая финишная, заполняющая Full+Finish Pufas / Пуфас 20 кг
records.reason: Официальная русскоязычная страница PUFAS и RU TDS подтверждают отдельный продукт Füll+Finish 20 кг, арт. 003007092, EAN 4007954030974. Текущая фотография показывает другую линейку Füll Spachtel FSI innen (20 кг; арт. 003007000, EAN 4007954030004), поэтому является ошибочной для MAT-000046. Подготовлен синтетический catalog render только для owner review; он не использует пиксели официальных изображений и не заявляется как подлинная фотография упаковки или cleared для production.
records.identityEvidence: MatMix public catalog record identifies Full+Finish Pufas, 20 kg. Official PUFAS product page and Russian TDS independently identify Füll+Finish 20 kg as article 003007092 / EAN 4007954030974. Official PUFAS FSI TDS lists a distinct 20 kg item 003007000 / EAN 4007954030004, matching the incorrect current pack model. Official front/back product media were inspected only as visual references; no source pixels were used in the synthetic candidate. Package design generation/date is not established.

exceptionSources.evidence: Füll+Finish; 20 кг; арт. 003007092; EAN 4007954030974; product category text identifies gypsum filling/finishing compound; official page links manufacturer media.
exceptionSources.rights: Official imprint says commercial use/reproduction of website texts/images requires prior PUFAS consent; image is visual reference only.

exceptionSources.evidence: Russian technical sheet names Füll+Finish; gypsum filler; distribution sizes and article mapping: 20 kg – 003007092; confirms exact model and pack.

Official current product media visually shows white sack, red PUFAS panel, yellow field, green diagonal bars, red bottom stripes and prominent Füll+Finish Spachtel text; used only for visual identity/design reference; not copied into candidate.
Official reverse-side media visibly associates article 003007092 and EAN 4007954030974 with 20 kg Full+Finish; visual reference only.
FSI is a distinct PUFAS interior filler; the 20 kg FSI SKU is item 003007000 / EAN 4007954030004, different from Full+Finish 003007092 / EAN 4007954030974.
PUFAS states commercial use/reproduction of website texts or images requires prior consent; no permission was obtained for this task.

records.visiblePackageIdentity: Synthetic review render showing prominent PUFAS / Füll+Finish Spachtel / 20 kg text and approximate major layout from official current media; not asserted to be an authentic manufacturer photo or dated package generation.

differencesFromFsi.currentImageModel: PUFAS Füll Spachtel FSI innen, 20 kg
differencesFromFsi.conclusion: Different product names and distinct article/EAN; current image is the wrong model for MAT-000046.
